title: Applications pending on many devices for a long time

maxPendingPct.text: Share still pending before delivery is stalled

settledDays.text: Days after assignment before pending stops being normal

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'application has', 'applications have')} not reached more than {params.maxPendingPct}% of their targets

messages.businessImpact: Neither installed nor failed, so nothing raises an alarm, while users continue not to have the software.
remediation: Check whether the devices are checking in at all before investigating the packages.
messages.cannotSee: Counts come from Intune's install summary report, which can lag the devices by a day. A device offline since the assignment counts as pending however long it has been away. Where the report cannot be read this rule is skipped rather than finding nothing pending.
